description: The clip view of an arrangement's audio clip: a strip with its switch and name that rolls the view up, then Clip (start, end), Loop (switch, position, length, ÷2, ×2) and Sample (Warp, Reverse, Crop, Gain, Transpose, speed) boxes in bars.beats.16ths, the last two foldable, beside its source on a timeline of its own (overview, bar ruler, the stretch it plays or loops to drag, warp markers on the waveform), drawn on the GPU when the source's samples are given and WebGL 2 is there: as its waveform, by band, or as its spectrogram, from the view menu. Given onProcess, the source is edited as in an audio editor: a bar over it with Edit, Process and View, a drag selects a stretch, a right-click opens Cut, Copy, Paste, Delete, Crop, Louder, Quieter and the Process menu, with their keys, each on the selection or all of the source; processedSettings says where the clip's start, end and loop go.
name: clip-panel
